---
title: "Brain Summary"
author: "May Wang"
---
The table from HPA shows the number of genes with regionally elevated expression in human, pig, and mouse.
This document aims to calculate the total number of regionally elevates genes in the forebrain in these three species.
```{r}
total_gene_number_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_gene_number_human)
```
```{r}
total_gene_number_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_gene_number_pig)
```
```{r}
total_gene_number_rat <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_gene_number_rat)
```
Humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
